description: Acts like an AI shopping agent on an online store and tests three stages: find (homepage answers, robots.txt lets shopping bots in, product feed, llms.txt), read (a product page with price, currency and stock in structured data, text readable without JavaScript, shipping and returns) and buy (product JSON, cart and checkout reachable without a login). Returns a score out of 100, a verdict (ready, partly, not), every check with its status, detail and fix, the access table for eight shopping and answer bots, and the product that was read. Read-only: about ten GET requests to public URLs, nothing is added to a cart. Shopify and WooCommerce get the full set of checks. Counts against the free daily limit unless the store was checked in the last ten minutes.

url.description: Store domain or homepage URL, for example store.com

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Check whether an AI shopping agent can buy from a store
